gloss: to give a ride, to put on

definitions.gloss: to give a ride, to let ride
definitions.explanation: To allow someone to board a vehicle.

definitions.gloss: to put on, to place on
definitions.explanation: To set something on a surface.

examples.japanese: {テーブル|てーぶる}に{乗|の}せる。

examples.english: I was tricked by their words.

notes:
{乗|の}せる means to give a ride or put on.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {乗|の}せる (transitive): to put on
- {乗|の}る (intransitive): to ride

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {乗|の}せる: to give a ride
- {載|の}せる: to publish, load
